Postgres.PORT: Private PostgreSQL port. Do not create a public TCP proxy.
Postgres.POSTGRES_DB: Database containing both warehouse tables and dlt destination state.
Postgres.POSTGRES_USER: Image initialization administrator; never used by the ingestion process.
Postgres.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generated database password; changing this variable alone does not rotate existing database roles.
Postgres.DLT_LOADER_PASSWORD: Separate generated password for the schema-scoped nonsuperuser dlt_loader role; initialized only on an empty volume.
Postgres.PGDATA: Database files below the single-service persistent volume mount.

dlt Loader.PGHOST: Destination private DNS hostname, not a public database endpoint.
dlt Loader.PGDATABASE: Database holding warehouse, staging schemas, and dlt pipeline state.
dlt Loader.PGUSER: Schema-scoped dlt_loader role; no superuser, role creation, database creation, or public-schema writes.
dlt Loader.PGPASSWORD: Reference to the dedicated ingestion password, never the administrator password.
dlt Loader.PGSSLMODE: libpq SSL mode; prefer on Railway private networking, verify-full for external TLS databases.
dlt Loader.SOURCE_BASE_URL: Required operator-supplied HTTPS REST API base URL; no embedded credentials.
dlt Loader.SOURCE_API_TOKEN: Required operator-supplied read-only API bearer token; not a generated token your upstream would recognize.
dlt Loader.SOURCE_ENDPOINT: Relative orders endpoint; returns data array and total_pages.
dlt Loader.SOURCE_PAGE_SIZE: page_size query parameter, integer 1..1000; API must support page-number pagination.
dlt Loader.SOURCE_INITIAL_CURSOR: Initial updated_at Unix-second watermark, nonnegative integer. Changing it does not reset existing state.
dlt Loader.SOURCE_LOOKBACK_SECONDS: Nonnegative cursor overlap for bounded late changes; does not capture old deletions or arbitrary backdated updates.
dlt Loader.ALLOW_INSECURE_SOURCE: Keep false in deployments. true allows the private HTTP test fixture only.
dlt Loader.PIPELINE_NAME: Stable lowercase pipeline identity; keep unchanged during replacement and upgrades.
dlt Loader.DATASET_NAME: Stable lowercase destination schema name; changing creates a separate dataset.
dlt Loader.PIPELINES_DIR: Ephemeral extraction/load scratch directory. Completed state restores from destination, not unfinished local packages.
